Name: Bose Wired Earphones
Details: Bose Noise Cancelling Wired Earbuds - in-Ear Headphones, USB-C Connection, Included Carry Case, in-Line Remote and Microphone, Black
product: Bose Noise Cancelling Wired Earbuds (USB-C, in-line remote and mic, carry case), Black, model 906940-0010
assumption: Assumed the current Bose USB-C wired ANC earbuds in Black, released in Australia on 15 Oct 2026. The postcode '78' isn't a valid AU postcode, so I haven't included delivery costs and have listed delivery as unknown or click & collect.

best.why: Matches The Good Guys at $169, and StaticICE showed it on 3 Nov 2026. I couldn't confirm stock on the JB Hi-Fi page itself, because it returned a rate-limit error when fetched. There is no discount anywhere. All retailers sit at the RRP of about $169.

offers.notes: Price from StaticICE listing dated 3 Nov 2026. A search snippet of the JB Hi-Fi page also showed $169, but an earlier snapshot marked it as not available.
The page showed $169 and an Add to Cart button, with no stock status shown. It also advertises a price beat.

tips: Every retailer I found sells at about the RRP of $169, so there's nothing to gain from shopping around yet.
Harvey Norman listed the White model at $168 for pre-order, which is $1 cheaper. I didn't verify its Black listing, so check that page.
JB Hi-Fi, The Good Guys and Harvey Norman all price match. If you find a lower price at a local competitor, ask them to match it.
The Black Friday and Click Frenzy sales are coming up. Bose products often get discounted then, so waiting may save money.
Check cashback through ShopBack or Cashrewards before you buy.
